policy: progress if consumer score >= 0.80 else review
modal: largest development-event fingerprint frequency; ties broken by repr order; no labels used

selective.lineage: Geifman and El-Yaniv, NeurIPS 2017, implemented as calibration-selected confidence rejection
selective.empty_replicate_rule: excluded from the percentile; never treated as zero error
selective.tie_break: among risk-qualified thresholds, maximum calibration coverage, then largest threshold

conformal.lineage: Angelopoulos and Bates, split conformal prediction
conformal.name: UserClusterSplitConformalActionSet
conformal.unit: one maximum nonconformity per calibration learner
conformal.order_statistic: k = ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); q is the kth ascending learner maximum; infinity if k > n
conformal.set_rule: include action a when 1 - p(a) <= q; empty sets are retained

absent_key: p=0.5 and NO_DEVELOPMENT_CLASS; modal returns no prediction
